snippet.title: EVA BATTLE ARENA - SEASON 8
snippet.description:
🚨 EMERGENCY LANDING 🚨

EVA BATTLE ARENA SEASON 8 IS LIVE! 🔥

🌴 Welcome to Reef Point, our brand-new map may look like paradise… but every fight could be your last.

What's new this season?
👔 6 new skin bundles: Compass, Ranger, Ionian, Guerilla, Tide Walker and Leviathan.

⚙️ New utilities, including:
Med Pack to quickly restore your health.
Echo to create a decoy and throw your opponents off.

Book your session via the link in our bio or at EVA.GG, and don't hesitate to share your feedback with us on Discord!

Good luck, soldiers. 🫡
